act_title: The National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Act, 1998
title: Acts and proceedings not to be invalidated by vacancies
text:
31. Acts and proceedings not to be invalidated by vacancies.—[No act of the Council or any

Institute] or Board or Senate or any other body set up under this Act or the Statutes, shall be invalid
merely by reason of—

(a) any vacancy in, or defect in, the constitution thereof, or

(b) any defect in the election, nomination or appointment of person acting as a member thereof, or

(c) any irregularity in its procedure not affecting the merits of the case.
